response.sql: SELECT AVG(customer_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) as customer_count FROM Customer WHERE SupportRepId IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SupportRepId) AS subquery

assumptions.assumption: A 'support rep' is an employee who has at least one customer assigned (SupportRepId is not NULL). The average counts only these support reps, not all employees.

alternatives.interpretation: If the average should be computed across all employees in the Employee table, including those with zero customers assigned
alternatives.sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS FLOAT) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Employee) FROM Customer WHERE SupportRepId IS NOT NULL
